title: Grusch's witness and the 300 ft triangle over a car

tellings.quote: but he mentioned a huge 300 ft triangle that somebody uh saw on their way to work.

plain: Someone driving to work saw a huge triangle, about 300 feet across, over their car, near Norfolk, Virginia, sometime in the 2010s. Michels says this was one of the witness accounts mentioned to him by David Grusch, a former US intelligence official who has testified to Congress about hidden programmes, so it comes to us third-hand: from the witness, to Grusch, to Michels.
